Title: Rejuvenate and Secure Haven plus another Q

Messages.Author: adam....@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Question came up a while ago.

Rejuvenate
During your untap phase, if this imbued has fewer life than his or her
starting amount, he or she gains 1 life. [Action] [1 Conviction] +1
stealth action. Add 1 blood to a vampire or 1 life to an other ally,
not to axceed starting life.

Secure Haven
Master: unique location. Haven. Put this card on a minion you control.
This minion cannot be affected by (D) actions. Any Methuselah burns an
additional pool when playing master cards on (or that target) this
minion. Burn this card if this minion enters torpor. A minion can have
only one haven.

I have an imbued with Rejuvenate and a vampire with secure haven. Can
I rejuvenate the vampire?'
I am checking because I thought when one of your minions does an
action against another of your own minions then it is UNdirected (and
then secure haven does not stop it).

--------------

Also, how much can a vagabond mystic "heal" for a Corrupt
construction. Similar questions for Healing Touch/Renewed Vigor/
Resurrection.

Adam
